title: SQL AG backup: COPY_ONLY via the AG primary
description: The nexus-cli backup take verb for the Always On AG: a COPY_ONLY backup of nexus_demo via the AG primary (honors backup-preference). The restore round-trip is the handbook playbook.

observe.what: the backupId; pass it to `nexus backup restore sqlserver-ag <id> --yes` for the RESTORE-WITH-MOVE round-trip (8225 rows)

whatProves: the AG database backs up via the primary; restore verifies the backup round-trips into a throwaway verify DB.
